crossRefs.note: Yahweh’s angel said to her, “I will greatly multiply your offspring, that they will not be counted for multitude.”
Now this is the history of the generations of Ishmael, Abraham’s son, whom Hagar the Egyptian, Sarah’s servant, bore to…
I will also make a nation of the son of the servant, because he is your child.”
Get up, lift up the boy, and hold him with your hand. For I will make him a great nation.”

people.name: Ishmael
people.line: Son of Abraham and Hagar; father of Arab tribes.

translations.web: As for Ishmael, I have heard you. Behold, I have blessed him, and will make him fruitful, and will multiply him exceedingly. He will become the father of twelve princes, and I will make him a great nation.
translations.bsb: As for Ishmael, I have heard you, and I will surely bless him; I will make him fruitful and multiply him greatly. He will become the father of twelve rulers, and I will make him into a great nation.
translations.kjv: And as for Ishmael, I have heard thee: Behold, I have blessed him, and will make him fruitful, and will multiply him exceedingly; twelve princes shall he beget, and I will make him a great nation.
translations.asv: And as for Ishmael, I have heard thee: behold, I have blessed him, and will make him fruitful, and will multiply him exceedingly; twelve princes shall he beget, and I will make him a great nation.
